purpose: Normalize EU marketplace trust, return, warranty, tested and delivery signals into reusable Parts Seller OS listing readiness rules.
principle: Learn trust mechanics from marketplaces. Do not copy wording, design or protected seller data.

rules.pattern: Buyer sees return guarantee before or near buying path.
rules.parts_os_rule: Listing readiness must store return_window_days or return_policy_state before external publishing.

rules.pattern: Used parts marketplaces present warranty/guarantee as buyer trust proof.
rules.parts_os_rule: Price confidence increases only if warranty_state is known; unknown warranty forces manual review for high-value parts.

rules.pattern: Marketplace can state that parts are tested by partner dismantlers before guarantee.
rules.parts_os_rule: Mechanical/electrical parts need tested_state before being sell_ready; if untested, listing status becomes hold_or_manual_review.

rules.pattern: Delivery country or destination selector is visible in marketplace flow.
rules.parts_os_rule: Listing cannot be cross_border_ready until package profile and delivery region are known.

rules.pattern: Marketplace shows network scale or partner sellers to create buyer trust and inventory breadth.
rules.parts_os_rule: Future marketplace roadmap needs seller trust card; one-seller OS needs internal stock quality card instead.

rules.pattern: Vague listing titles can exist but reduce buyer confidence.
rules.parts_os_rule: QA blocks external publish if title is vague, side is missing where required, or OEM/code is missing for code-sensitive parts.

next_actions: Verify B-Parts and Autoparts24 trust/warranty/delivery signals.
Add 20 more trust rules across EU sellers.
Wire rules into Parts Seller OS listing readiness UI.
